anomalies.observed: The LDO output is on net +3.3V, while the MCU supply net +3V3 has no REG2 source. All FCC1 and NAVC1 VDD pins appear only in generated unconnected-(...-VDD...) nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3.3 V rail should feed both MCUs; FCC1 and NAVC1 VDD pins should be connected to the 3V3/+3.3V supply net.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Both microcontrollers are unpowered and the +3V3 pull-up/VBAT net has no supply, so the board cannot boot or operate.

anomalies.observed: The NAVC-side sensor I2C nets contain the IMU, magnetometer, barometer, temperature sensor and EEPROM, but no NAVC1 pin nodes. The NAVC-side UART2, I2C link, and GPIO link nets similarly contain only resistors or one-side nodes and no NAVC1 connections.
anomalies.expected: NAVC1 should be connected to its sensor I2C bus and to FCC through the intended UART2 + I2C + GPIO inter-MCU link.

anomalies.impact: The navigation computer is isolated from its sensors and from the flight-control computer, so navigation data and inter-MCU communication cannot function.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 VCAP power pins 48 and 73 are connected to UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC, which also go to the UART3 connector.
anomalies.expected: STM32H753 VCAP pins should connect only to their decoupling capacitors to ground; UART3 signals should connect to MCU UART pins, not internal regulator capacitor nodes.
anomalies.impact: Internal MCU regulator capacitor nodes are shorted to UART lines, which can disturb or prevent MCU startup and makes UART3 unusable.

We need answer JSON only. Need review PCB design files vs spec. Need identify anomaly if supported. We must think thoroughly. Need inspect netlist and SPICE. Need compare to spec. Potential anomalies: barometer reset/EOC mixed up is known logged bug, not anomaly. Need check other deviations.

We need parse netlist. Key components: FCC1 STM32H753VITx, NAVC1 STM32F405RGTx. Sensors: BMI088 U5, IIS2MDCTR U8, MPRLS U7, TMP100 U6, EEPROM U9, GPS U10. FCC peripherals PCA9685 U2, EEPROM U3, FLASH U4. Power: REG1 MIC26903, REG2 LD39200, INA219 U1, R1 0.01.

Need find deviations from intended design. Let's systematically check.

Spec: FCC and NAVC connected by UART2 + I2C + GPIO. In netlist: UART2_TX_FCC net FCC1 pin25 PA3 to R49 pin2; UART2_RX_NAVC net R49 pin1. UART2_TX_NAVC net R48 pin1; UART2_RX_FCC net R48 pin2 to FCC1 pin28 PA4. So UART2 via series resistors R48/R49? Wait names: R48 value 10, R49 value 10. UART2_TX_NAVC -> R48 pin1, UART2_RX_FCC -> R48 pin2 -> FCC1 PA4. UART2_TX_FCC -> R49 pin2, UART2_RX_NAVC -> R49 pin1. So TX to RX cross? FCC TX (PA3) through R49 to UART2_RX_NAVC (NAVC RX). NAVC TX through R48 to FCC RX. Good.

I2C between MCUs: spec says I2C. Netlist: I2C1_SCL_FCC net FCC1 PB7, R50 pin2, R9 pin2, TP1. I2C2_SCL_NAVC net R50 pin1. I2C1_SDA_FCC net FCC1 PB8, R51 pin2, R10 pin2, TP2. I2C2_SDA_NAVC net R51 pin1. So R50/R51 0 ohms connect FCC I2C1 to NAVC I2C2? Names weird but connectivity: FCC I2C1 to NAVC I2C2 via 0R. Good.

GPIO A-H: R40-R47 10 ohm between GPIO_x_FCC and GPIO_x_NAVC. But netlist: GPIO_H_FCC net R47 pin2 only; GPIO_H_NAVC R47 pin1. No FCC1 pin for GPIO_H? Actually net 25 GPIO_H_FCC only R47.2. There is no FCC1. Maybe unconnected? Let's check FCC1 pins: pin 56 PD9 -> GPIO_A_FCC; 57 PD10 -> B; 58 PD11 -> C; 59 PD12 -> D; 60 PD13 -> E; 61 PD14 -> F; 62 PD15 -> G; H? PD? FCC1 pin? There are unconnected FCC1 pins PD8-PD7 etc. GPIO_H_FCC missing MCU connection. But spec says GPIO between two MCUs? Could be an anomaly? Need see if intended Hades has GPIO link 8 signals? Netlist has R47 with one side named GPIO_H_FCC but no FCC pin. The other side GPIO_H_NAVC also no NAVC pin? Wait NAVC1 pins for GPIO? Netlist shows NAVC1 mostly unconnected; GPIO_A_NAVC net only R40 pin1; GPIO_B_NAVC only R41 pin1; etc. None connect to NAVC1. So these GPIO nets are only series resistors with no MCU pins? That seems suspicious. Let's inspect: net 11 GPIO_A_FCC: FCC1 pin56 PD9, R40 pin2. net 12 GPIO_A_NAVC: R40 pin1 only. So R40 connects FCC GPIO to NAVC net, but NAVC net not connected to NAVC1. Similarly all. Is that intended? Maybe NAVC GPIO pins unconnected in schematic? Could be missing connections? But spec says GPIO between two MCUs. It says confirmed in Hades.sch: NAVC↔FCC run UART2 + I2C + GPIO between the two MCUs. If netlist shows GPIO link resistors but no NAVC1 pins, that's an anomaly (open connection / missing component?) But maybe NAVC1 pins not listed because no_connect? Need check NAVC1 unconnected nets: many pins unconnected. No net named GPIO_x_NAVC connected to NAVC1. So yes, the GPIO link is incomplete on NAVC side. But could be intentional? The reference design maybe has GPIO link only from FCC to test points? But spec explicitly says GPIO between MCUs. Need evaluate if this is an anomaly introduced in build. However the netlist may be from design files, not layout; if a net has only R40.1, it's an open connection. Is that enough? But maybe NAVC1 GPIO pins are not connected due to software? But spec says intended. Could be deliberate tampering? Need rank.

But need search for more obvious anomalies. Check power rails.

Spec: 5V from MIC26903, feedback Vout=0.8*(1+R5/R6). Netlist: R5 6k8, R6 1k3. Vout=0.8*(1+6800/1300)=0.8*(1+5.2308)=4.9846 V. Good. R4 19k6, C6? There is R4 from Net-(C6-Pad2) to REG_FB, R5 +5V to REG_FB, R6 0 to REG_FB. Wait feedback divider: R5 top from +5V to FB, R6 bottom from FB to GND. R4 and C6? Net-(C6-Pad2) connects C6 pin2 and R4 pin1. C6 pin1 is REG_CS (switch node). R4 pin2 is REG_FB. So R4 19k6 from FB to switch node? That seems unusual. Maybe feedforward? Spec only mentions R5/R6. Could be OK? Need check MIC26903 datasheet? It may have compensation? But R4 from FB to SW? Let's examine: net REG_CS includes L1 pin1, C5 pin1, C6 pin1, REG1 SW pins, CS. Net Net-(C6-Pad2) includes C6 pin2 and R4 pin1. Net REG_FB includes C7 pin2, R4 pin2, R5 pin2, R6 pin2, REG1 FB. So R4 connects FB to switch node? C6 connects switch node to FB? This is weird: a capacitor from switch node to FB plus resistor from switch node to FB? Maybe for ripple injection? Not in spec. Could be anomaly? Need compare to reference? Spec says feedback divider relation Vout=0.8*(1+R5/R6); doesn't mention R4/C6. But may be design for MIC26903? Need know. MIC26903 has FB? Maybe R4/C6 for feed-forward? Could be not anomaly.

Check input caps: C1 100u, C2 47u on REG_VIN. Spec says C1,C2 rated >=35V. Footprints: C1 C_Elec_6.3x7.7 (electrolytic), C2 C_1210. Values okay. But C1 and C2 are unpolarized capacitor symbols; electrolytic footprint. Could be wrong polarity? No polarity info. Not anomaly likely.

REG1 pins: PVIN all to REG_VIN; VIN pin27 to REG_VIN; PVDD pin1 to Net-(REG1-PVDD) with C3 2u2; VDD pin28 to Net-(D1-A) with D1 Schottky cathode? Check REG2 LD39200: pin1 OUT to +3.3V, pin2 ADJ/SENSE to +3.3V (fixed version tie OUT to SENSE), pin5 EN +5V, pin6 IN +5V, pin3 GND GND, pin7 EPAD GND. Good. PG unconnected.

INA219: U1 pin1 VIN+ to VIN+ net (BAT1 + and R1 pin2). pin2 VIN- to REG_VIN (R1 pin1). pin3 GND, pin4 VS +3.3V, pin5 SCL I2C2_SCL_FCC, pin6 SDA I2C2_SDA_FCC, pin7 A0 GND, pin8 A1 GND. LED8-15 unconnected. EXTCLK unconnected. Good.

PCA9685 addr 0x40 if A0 high? Hmm. EEPROM 24CW1280 addr 0x50. Netlist U3 no address pins? 24CW1280 in SOT-23-5 has fixed? Maybe A0? Actually 24CW1280T-I/OT SOT-23-5: pins SCL, VSS, SDA, VCC, NC? U5 BMI088: pin3 VDD +3.3V, pin11 VDDIO +3.3V, pin4 GNDA GND, pin6 GNDIO GND, pin7 PS +3.3V? Good. But spec says BMI088 I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr). Address depends on SDO/PS? For BMI088 in I2C mode, PS high selects I2C; CSB1 high? SDO1/SDO2 high? Address maybe 0x68? U6 TMP100: pin1 SCL I2C1_SCL_NAVC, pin6 SDA I2C1_SDA_NAVC, pin4 V+ +3.3V, pin2 GND, pin3 ADD1 +3.3V, pin5 ADD0 +3.3V. Spec addr 0x4E. TMP100 address bits ADD0/ADD1? 0x48 base; ADD1=1 ADD0=1 => 0x4E? Yes.

MCU power: FCC1 VDD pins? Netlist: FCC1 pin11 VDD unconnected? Let's check: FCC1 pin 11 VDD in unconnected-(FCC1-VDD-Pad11). pin27 VDD unconnected, pin50 VDD unconnected, pin75 VDD unconnected, pin100 VDD unconnected. That's a huge anomaly! Check NAVC1: pin1 VBAT +3V3; pin13 VDDA VDDA_NAVC (C51 only, no NAVC1? Wait VDDA_NAVC net includes C51 pin1, NAVC1 pin13 VDDA. Good). NAVC1 VDD pins: pin19,32,48,64 unconnected? NAVC1 VSS pins: pin18/63 net Net-(NAVC1-VSS-Pad18) only NAVC1 pins 18 and 63, not GND! pin12 VSSA unconnected. So NAVC1 also unpowered? Wait +3V3 includes NAVC1 pin1 VBAT only. VDD pins unconnected.
